description: This file contains functional tests for the AccountController's sign-in and account management features in the eShopOnWeb project, using Xunit for testing ASP.NET Core MVC application endpoints.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the AccountController's login and account management actions.

methods.name: AccountControllerSignIn
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpClient for test requests.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the login page returns a successful response containing the expected email.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Verifies that the regex correctly matches the request verification token in HTML input.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Ensures that the login page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates a login POST with valid credentials and verifies redirection behavior.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Logs in a user, updates the phone number on the profile, and verifies the update.
